III. Reading Comprehension Passage (32–37)

Many teenagers enjoy different leisure activities. Some like spending time with friends, while others prefer staying at home and messaging friends or surfing the net.

Minh likes going for a bike ride with his friends. He says it helps him improve health and relax. Lan enjoys cooking with her family. She often looks for easy recipes and prepares food on special occasions.

These activities help teenagers connect with others and reduce stress.

MINI REVIEW & GRAMMAR SUMMARY

Tóm tắt kiến thức cốt lõi Unit 1: Leisure Time

1. Từ vựng trọng tâm (Key Vocabulary)

  • leisure time /'leʒə taɪm/: thời gian rảnh rỗi
  • go for a bike ride: đi xe đạp
  • recipe /'resəpi/: công thức nấu ăn
  • reduce stress: giảm căng thẳng

2. Cấu trúc ngữ pháp cần nhớ

  • Verb + V-ing: enjoy / like / love / fancy + V-ing
    Ví dụ: I enjoy cooking with my family.
  • Be keen on / interested in / fond of + V-ing:
    Ví dụ: She is keen on taking photos.
  • Spend time + V-ing: dành thời gian làm gì
    Ví dụ: We spend time riding bikes.
